Costruisci il percorso direttamente sull: Build the route directly on the map: click an artwork to add it as the next stop, click an empty point to insert a turn. To change floor, click the stairs or the elevator to attach the route there, then pick the other floor from the menu below and click the matching stairs/elevator to continue from there. Stops are numbered in click order; you can reorder or remove them from the Route tab too.
